title: Removal of the Aft Cargo Compartment Ceiling and Sidewall Lining Panels
abstract: Removal of the ceiling and sidewall lining panels from the aft cargo compartment, with the panel accountability and the smoke barrier caution that apply because the lining is a certified fire containment boundary.

sections.purpose: This task removes the ceiling and sidewall lining panels from the aft cargo compartment so that the structure, the wiring and the insulation behind them can be reached.
sections.job_setup_note: The cargo lining is a certified fire containment boundary. Every panel removed must be recorded so that the same panel returns to the same position, and no panel may be substituted by an uncertified item. The lining also carries the smoke detection sampling path, so the compartment must not be returned to service with any panel missing. Cargo lighting must be isolated before the ceiling panels are lowered.
sections.procedure: 1. Isolate the cargo compartment lighting and the smoke detection system, and put the warning notices in the flight compartment. WARNING: THE SMOKE DETECTION SYSTEM IS INHIBITED DURING THIS TASK. THE COMPARTMENT MUST NOT BE LOADED AND THE AIRCRAFT MUST NOT BE RELEASED TO SERVICE. 2. Get access through the aft cargo door and work in zones 131, 134, 143 and 146. 3. Record the position of every panel on the accountability sheet before removal. 4. Release the latches D2550114658909 along the ceiling panel edges. 5. Lower the ceiling panels one at a time and support them; do not let a panel hang on its remaining latch. CAUTION: THE CEILING PANELS ARE LARGE AND FLEXIBLE. UNSUPPORTED, THEY WILL CRACK AT THE LATCH CUT-OUTS AND BECOME UNSERVICEABLE. 6. Disconnect the lighting kit D2550118482429 at each ceiling position and cap the connectors. 7. Remove the sidewall panels and the restraint decor panel D2550136675057. 8. Inspect the exposed insulation blankets for wetness, contamination and displacement, and record the finding. 9. Inspect the smoke detection sampling ports for obstruction. 10. Stack the removed panels on edge in a rack, not flat, and label each with its position. 11. Cover the exposed wiring runs against damage.
sections.close_out: Confirm that the accountability sheet lists every panel removed. Leave the warning notices in place and keep the smoke detection system inhibited until the lining is restored. Make an entry in the aircraft technical log that the cargo compartment fire containment boundary is open and that the compartment must not be loaded.

safety_precautions: Inhibit the smoke detection system and put the warning notices in the flight compartment.
Do not load the compartment while the lining is removed.
Support every panel before you release the last latch.
Isolate the cargo lighting before you lower the ceiling panels.
